Textron finds private equity buyer for industrial business at $1.2B
summary: An affiliate of Kingswood Capital Management will oversee the industrial segment, which includes an auto supplier and specialty vehicles. This aligns with Textron’s shift to become a pure-play aerospace and defense company.
